en.title: Palindromic Substrings Counted by Position
en.description:
Count all palindromic substrings; the same text occurring at different positions is counted separately. The original body is truncated, but aaa→6 and its enumeration make this rule clear; it differs from the distinct-text count of problem 4.

The input/output protocol was compiled by this site; missing numeric bounds and recoveries of source typos are all stated explicitly.
en.input: One line containing a lowercase string; complete original bound 1≤length≤1000.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 3; 6; 6. These answers were verified by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Enumerate each character as a center and each gap between adjacent characters as a center, expanding outward on both sides simultaneously; each match contributes one palindrome.
